newsitem.title: USA: Penn National acquiring Charles Town track.
newsitem.headline: Penn National acquiring Charles Town track.

text.p: Penn National Gaming Inc said Wednesday that it will exercise its option to buy the Charles Town race track in West Virginia for about $16.5 million.
"Charles Town represents a solid acquisition for Penn National as it will significantly enhance our revenue and earnings," said Penn Chief Executive Peter Carlino.
Penn said the acquisition of the Charles Town Races would be completed through its joint venture with Bryant Development Co.
Penn would own 80 percent of the facility and said it would manage operations and a $16 million refurbishment scheduled to begin upon closing.

The deal is to to close in early December. It was contingent on a referendum to permit the installation of video lottery terminals at the track. Penn said Jefferson County voters approved the referendum Tuesday.
Penn said based on current plans, it expects to be open for racing and gaming in the second quarter 1997.
Penn has scheduled a conference call at 1000 EST/1500 GMT to discuss the acquisition and third quarter earnings, announced earlier today.
The company reported earnings of $0.21 per share for the quarter.
Penn National rose to trade at 41-1/4 late Wednesday morning, up from Tuesday's 36-1/4 close.
